breakdown.description: The prompt switches from the exact thick-walled torsion relation given in the setup to a thin-walled tube approximation, which is a different model.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification still includes the thin-walled closed-tube shear-flow approximation (computing A_m, q = T/(2·A_m), τ_thin = q/t, J_thin, and φ_thin), framing it as a 'cross-check' and asking to report both values with a percentage difference. The ground truth prompt removes the thin-walled model entirely and uses only the exact thick-walled torsion formulas (J = π(do^4−di^4)/32, τ_max = T·(do/2)/J, φ = T·L/(G·J)). The agent did not eliminate the inconsistency; it merely demoted the thin-walled approach to a secondary role while still including it.
